name: learn-it
description: Turn notes, a photo of a textbook page or a document into a Learn It quiz, opened by one short link.

interface.longDescription:
Send a photo of a textbook page or a handwritten word list, attach a document, paste your notes, or just say what you want to practice. You get one short link that opens the quiz in Learn It, where you see every question before you add it.

Learn It is an app for practicing vocabulary and quiz questions on iPhone and iPad, used by more than 300,000 students, most of them in Sweden. Practicing there is different from being asked questions in a chat. For a decade, since 2016, the app has been refined around what you see, hear and feel at every answer: animation, sound and haptic feedback tuned to keep practice short, focused and rewarding. That is particularly helpful for students with learning challenges, who often find it hard to get started and to keep going. You practice with multiple choice, by writing the answers, or with flashcards.

Learn It also keeps track of what you have learned. It keeps a record of every word you practice and uses spaced repetition to show which words are due for review, at growing intervals, so you go back to them before you forget them.

There is no account and nothing to sign in to. On a device without the app, the link shows the quiz on trylearnit.com. Ask for changes at any time and you get a new link.

To make the link, the quiz (its name, questions and answers) is sent to Learn It and stored there under a quiz code, the same way a quiz shared from the app is. Anyone who has the link or the code can open the quiz, so leave personal information out of it. Nothing else from your conversation is sent to Learn It.
capabilities: Make a quiz to practice in Learn It
defaultPrompt: Make a Learn It quiz from this photo of my word list.
Make a Learn It quiz with 20 questions about the French Revolution.
Turn my notes into a Learn It quiz.

positive.description: A quiz on a topic, with nothing sent but the request
positive.prompt: Make a Learn It quiz with 10 questions about the planets of the solar system.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_quiz once with a short title and 10 question and answer pairs, each answer a name, a number or a few words. Chooses how the quiz opens (mode); if it opens in multiple choice, gives each card two wrong answers of the same kind that are plausible but clearly wrong (wrong). Answers with one link of the form https://trylearnit.com/c/<code> as a plain link, says in one sentence which way the quiz opens and why, and that changes can be asked for. Does not write the quiz out as a list and does not quiz the user in the chat.

positive.description: The user's own word list, kept word for word
positive.prompt: Make a Learn It quiz from these words: der Hund = the dog, die Katze = the cat, das Haus = the house, die Kinder (pl.) = the children.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_quiz with exactly these four pairs, the German words with their articles and the note (pl.) unchanged, and gives the returned link.

positive.description: Notes to practice explaining: the quiz opens as flashcards
positive.prompt: Turn my notes into a Learn It quiz so I can practice explaining them: Photosynthesis is how plants make sugar from light, water and carbon dioxide. It happens in the chloroplasts, where chlorophyll absorbs the light. Oxygen is released as a by-product.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_quiz with mode flashcards and pairs taken from the notes only, such as 'How do plants make sugar?' with an answer of a sentence from the notes. Gives the returned link and says in one sentence that the quiz opens as flashcards, why, and that it can be switched in Learn It.

positive.description: A change to a quiz already made in the conversation
positive.prompt: Add five more facts about the planets to that quiz and make the questions a little harder.
positive.expected_behavior: After the first case in the same conversation: calls create_quiz again with the whole changed quiz, not only the new pairs, and gives the new link.

positive.prompt: Gör ett förhör i Learn It med 15 spanska matord.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls create_quiz with a Swedish title and 15 pairs of a Swedish word and its Spanish translation, and answers in Swedish with the returned link.

negative.description: A question that is not a request for a quiz: answered without the tool
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Slovakia?

negative.description: Something the plugin cannot do: it only makes new quizzes, it cannot read, change or remove what is in someone's Learn It app
negative.prompt: Show me the quizzes I already have in Learn It and delete the old ones.

negative.description: Personal information about other people: the assistant should decline or leave it out, since anyone with the link can read the quiz
negative.prompt: Make a Learn It quiz with my classmates' full names, home addresses and phone numbers.

review.commerce_description: The plugin sells nothing and takes no payments.

publication.release_notes: For a quiz of facts that opens in multiple choice, the assistant now gives each question two wrong answers of the same kind that are plausible but clearly wrong, such as the wrong years or neighboring countries, so the options are no longer answers to other questions. Word lists keep using their other words as options.

sv-SE.subtitle: Gör ett förhör i Learn It
sv-SE.description:
Skicka ett foto av en sida i läroboken eller en handskriven gloslista, bifoga ett dokument, klistra in dina anteckningar eller berätta bara vad du vill öva på. Du får en kort länk som öppnar förhöret i Learn It, där du ser alla frågor innan du lägger till det.

Learn It är en app där du övar på glosor och läxfrågor på iPhone och iPad. Den används av mer än 300 000 elever, de flesta i Sverige. Att öva där är något annat än att få frågor i en chatt. I tio år, sedan 2016, har appen slipats kring det du ser, hör och känner vid varje svar: animationer, ljud och haptik som är avvägda för att hålla övningen kort, fokuserad och belönande. Det hjälper särskilt elever med inlärningssvårigheter, som ofta har svårt att komma igång och att hålla i. Du övar med flerval, genom att skriva svaren eller med flashcards.

Learn It håller också reda på vad du har lärt dig. Appen sparar hur det har gått för varje ord du övar på och visar med spridd repetition vilka ord som är redo att repeteras, med allt längre mellanrum, så att du går tillbaka till dem innan du glömmer dem.

Det finns inget konto och inget att logga in på. På en enhet utan appen visar länken förhöret på trylearnit.com. Be om ändringar när du vill, så får du en ny länk.

För att göra länken skickas förhöret (namn, frågor och svar) till Learn It och sparas där under en förhörskod, på samma sätt som när ett förhör delas från appen. Alla som har länken eller koden kan öppna förhöret, så lämna personuppgifter utanför. Inget annat ur din konversation skickas till Learn It.
